summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by IRSA Investments & Representations Inc., an Argentine real estate company, to disclose the upcoming payment of interest and principal on its Fixed Rate Series XIV Notes due 2028. The filing details the eighth interest installment (100% of interest) and third capital installment (17.5% of capital) to be paid on June 22, 2026, for notes originally issued July 8, 2022. The nominal outstanding is USD 67.14 million, with USD 2.94 million in interest and USD 18.08 million in capital paid. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural change is involved. This is a standard debt service notice, not a special situation.
